δάκτυλος, -ου, ὁ 
 [in LXX chiefly for אֶצְבַּע ;] 
a finger: Mat.23:4, Mrk.7:33, Luk.11:46 16:24, Jhn.8:6, 8 20:25, 27; metaphorically, δ. θεοῦ (cf. Exo.8:19), Luk.11:20.†
 (AS)

δεκτός, -ή, -όν 
 verbal adj. of δέχομαι, [in LXX chiefly for רָצוֹן: Pro.11:1, al. ;] 
acceptable: Luk.4:19 (LXX) 24, Act.10:35, 2Co.6:2" (LXX), Php.4:18 (cf. εὐπροσδ-).†
 (AS)

Αἰνέας, -οῦ, ὁ, 
 Æneas: Act.9:33,34.†
 (AS)

διώκω 
 [in LXX chiefly for רָדַף ;] 
__1. to put to flight, drive away: Mat.23:34. 
 __2. to pursue; 
 __(a) of persons; with accusative, without hostility, to follow after: Luk.17:23; with hostile purpose: Act.26:11, Rev.12:13. Hence, to persecute: Mat.5:10-12, 44 10:23, Luk.11:49 21:12, Jhn.5:16 15:20, Act.7:52 9:4-5 22:4, 7-8 26:14-15 Rom.12:14, 1Co.4:12 15:9, 2Co.4:9, Gal.1:13, 23 4:29 5:11 6:12, Php.3:6, 2Ti.3:12; 
 __(b) metaphorically, with accusative of thing(s), of seeking eagerly after: Rom.9:30, 1Ti.6:11, 2Ti.2:22; νόμον δικαιοσύνης, Rom.9:31; τ. φιλοξενίαν, Rom.12:13; εἰρήνην, Heb.12:14, 1Pe.3:11; τὰ τῆς εἰ., Rom.14:19; τ. ἀγάπην, 1Co.14:1; τὸ ἀγαθόν, 1Th.5:15; absol., to follow on, drive, or speed on (Æsch.), Php.3:12, 14.†
 (AS)

εἰσ-φέρω 
 [in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא hi. ;] 
to bring in, into: with accusative of person(s), Luk.5:18-19; before εἰς, Mat.6:13, Luk.11:4; ἐπί, Luk.12:11; with accusative of thing(s), before εἰς, 1Ti.6:7; pass., Heb.13:11.†
 (AS)

ἐξακόσιοι, -αι, -α. 
 six hundred: Rev.13:18 14:20.†
 (AS)

Ἰκόνιον, -ου, τό 
 Iconium, a city of the province of Galatia: Act.13:51 14:1, 19 14:21 16:2, 2Ti.3:11.†
 (AS)

καθαρότης, -ητος, ἡ
 (καθαρός), [in LXX: Exo.24:10 (טֹהַר), Wis.7:24 * ;] 
purity, cleanness: with genitive, Heb.9:13.†
 (AS)

καπηλεύω
 (κάπηλος, a huckster, cf. Isa.1:22 (LXX), Sir.26:29) 
to make a trade of (RV, mg., make merchandise of), or perhaps (cf. Isa, l.with) to corrupt (RV, tit.): 2Co.2:17.†
 (AS)

ἅμα 
 adv., 
at once (Lat. simul): Act.24:26 27:40, Rom.3:12 (one and all = יַחַד, Psa.14:3), Col.4:3, 1Ti.5:13, Phm 22; before σύν, 1Th.4:17 5:10; as prep. with dative, together with: Mat.13:29 (see MM, VGT, see word); also, with adv., ἅ. πρωΐ (cl., ἅ. ἕω, etc.), early in the morning: Mat.20:1.†
 (AS)

κυρόω, -ῶ
 (κῦρος, 1. authority. 2. validity), [in LXX for קוּם ;] 
to confirm, ratify, make valid: 2Co.2:8; pass., Gal.3:15 (cf. προ-κυρόω).†
 (AS)

Λαοδικεύς, -έως, ὁ 
 a Laodicean: Col.4:16.†
 (AS)

πάλιν, adv., 
 [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;] 
 __1. of place, back, backwards (LS, see word). 
 __2. Of time, again, once more: Mat.4:8, Mrk.2:13, Luk.23:20, Jhn.1:35 (and freq.), Act.17:32, Rom.11:23, Gal.1:9, Heb.1:6, al; pleonastically, π. ἀνακάμπτειν, Act.18:21; ὑποστρέφειν, Gal.1:17; εἰς τὸ π., 2Co.13:2; π. ἐκ τρίτου (Bl., §81, 4), Mat.26:44; ἐκ δευτέρου, Mat.26:42, Act.10:15; π. δεῦτερον, Jhn.4:54 21:16; π. ἄνωθεν ( Wis.19:6), Gal.4:9. 
 __3. Rhetorically, again; 
__(a) further, moreover: Mat.5:33, Luk.13:20, Jhn.12:39, al.; 
 __(b) in turn, on the other hand (Soph.; LXX: Wis.13:8 16:23, al.): Luk.6:43, 1Co.12:21, 2Co.10:7, 1Jn.2:8.
 (AS)

παν-δοχεῖον (-δοκίον, Τ), -ου, τό 
 (πανδοχεύς), 
late form of Att.. πανδοκεῖον, 
 an inn (khân, caravanserai): Luk.10:34.†
 (AS)

πόρρωθεν 
 adv. (τόρρω, which see), [in LXX for רָחוֹק and cogn. forms ;] 
from afar: Luk.17:12, Heb.11:13.†
 (AS)

Φάλεκ (T, Rec. Φαλέκ, L, mg., Φάλεγ), ὁ indecl. (Heb. D, Ge 1116), 
 Peleg: Luk.3:35.†
 (AS)

ἀφ-υπιόω, -ῶ
 (ὑπνόω, to put to sleep), [in Al.: Gen.28:11 * ;] 
__1. to awake from sleep (Anth.). 
 __2. = cl. καθυπνόω (MM, see word), to fall asleep: Luk.8:23.†
 (AS)

βεβαίωσις, -εως, ἡ 
 (βεβαιόω, which see), [in LXX: Lev.25:23 (צְמִיתֻת), Wis.6:19 * ;] 
confirmation: τ. εὐαγγελίου, Php.1:7; εἰς β., Heb.6:16, a phrase frequently in π. of guarantee in a business transaction (Deiss., BS, 104ff.; Cremer, 140).†
 (AS)
